frontmatter.name: ecmis
frontmatter.description: End-to-end fill/update of the E-CMIS Master Activity Template one Activity at a time — convert source documents with markitdown, extract data, verify against code, update the Excel output, validate it, and create Playwright tests per user flow for prototypes that lack them, pausing for the user only at decision points. Use when the user runs /ecmis or asks to do/update an E-CMIS Activity (ทำ/อัปเดต Activity ของ E-CMIS).
